pack.topic: Manual Sheet Metal Profile Bending Precision
pack.source_script_insight: Custom manual bending brakes enable rapid, highly uniform sheet metal channel production directly on site using simple mechanical leverage.
pack.coimbatore_angle: For Coimbatore residential construction, custom site-fabricated metal profiles ensure exact-fit flashings and edge channels without delay.
pack.core_takeaway: Using a rigid manual bending jig produces consistent 90-degree metal profiles for precise site fitment.
pack.voiceover_tamil: தளத்தில் கஸ்டம் சீட் பெண்டிங் jig. சரியான clamping alignment. ஒரே சீரான 90 டிகிரி வளைவு. வேகமான manual process. துல்லியமான U-channel profile. கசிவு இல்லாத கச்சிதமான fit. ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ பில்டர்ஸ் தரமான வேலை.

scenes.purpose: Visual Hook showing manual bending jig in action on a Coimbatore building site.
scenes.visual: A site worker wearing safety gloves and vest pulls out a freshly bent steel U-channel from a manual steel bending jig.
scenes.camera: Eye-level handheld gimbal tracking medium shot, subtle push-in.

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate precise alignment under the clamping angle bar.
scenes.visual: Close-up of thin silver galvanised sheet metal sliding under the steel angle clamping bar, aligned flush to the stop marker.
scenes.camera: Low-angle close-up shot, static focus on clamping bar edge.

scenes.visual: Operator pulls the hinged counterweighted bending handle upward, folding the sheet edge into a crisp 90-degree angle.
scenes.camera: Side-profile medium shot, quick upward tilt following handle motion.

scenes.purpose: Show material flip and repositioning for the second flange.
scenes.visual: Worker flips the sheet metal piece 180 degrees and re-inserts the opposite unbent edge into the clamping gap.

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate completion of the U-channel profile.
scenes.visual: Operator pulls the bending lever again, producing a finished, perfectly symmetrical U-shaped profile.
scenes.camera: Three-quarter tight shot focusing on the bending seam.

scenes.purpose: Show site application and fitment test.
scenes.visual: Worker aligns the completed U-channel against a roof edge beam section, showing zero gap and exact fitment.
scenes.camera: High-angle close-up looking down at the beam joint.

scenes.purpose: Final quality takeaway with stack of uniform finished channels.
scenes.visual: Worker places the completed channel onto a neat stack of identical site-fabricated metal profiles with bright daylight.
scenes.camera: Medium pan revealing a stack of finished metal profiles.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
OliveTree Builders video concept. Target audience: COIMBATORE ONLY. Total duration: EXACTLY 10 SECONDS across EXACTLY 7 SCENES in native 9:16 portrait format. Must feature PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE (at least 90% photorealistic visuals, no toon, cartoon, flat 2D explainer, CGI plastic look, or 3D animations). Motion graphics are restricted to minor text callouts only.

Setting: Active residential construction site in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, under natural bright Indian sunlight. Real site surroundings including brick masonry, concrete dust, metal stock, and working tools.

Scene 1 (0.0s - 1.4s): Eye-level medium tracking shot. A construction worker wearing high-vis orange vest and dark protective gloves lifts a freshly folded sheet metal U-channel from a heavy steel manual bending brake jig mounted on a sawhorse frame. Overlay text: 'Site Bending Jig'. Audio context: Ambient site clanking. Tamil VO: 'தளத்தில் கஸ்டம் சீட் பெண்டிங் jig.'

Scene 2 (1.4s - 2.8s): Tight close-up of thin galvanised sheet metal with protective film sliding under a heavy steel angle clamping bar. Hands align the sheet parallel to the bending edge. Overlay text: 'Exact Clamping'. Tamil VO: 'சரியான clamping alignment.'

Scene 3 (2.8s - 4.2s): Side profile medium shot. Primary worker smoothly pulls the hinged bending brake lever upward, folding the sheet edge into a sharp 90-degree flange. Overlay text: 'Clean 90° Bend'. Tamil VO: 'ஒரே சீரான 90 டிகிரி வளைவு.'

Scene 4 (4.2s - 5.6s): Over-the-shoulder close-up. The worker rapidly flips the metal sheet 180 degrees and re-inserts the flat edge under the clamp bar. Assistant holds the far end steady. Overlay text: 'Fast Cycle'. Tamil VO: 'வேகமான manual process.'

Scene 5 (5.6s - 7.0s): Three-quarter tight shot. Second lever pull creates the second flange, forming a clean U-channel profile. Overlay text: 'Uniform Profile'. Tamil VO: 'துல்லியமான U-channel profile.'

Scene 6 (7.0s - 8.4s): High-angle close-up on roof fascia beam line. A worker places the folded profile against the framing edge, confirming seamless flush fitment. Overlay text: 'Exact Fitment'. Tamil VO: 'கசிவு இல்லாத கச்சிதமான fit.'

Scene 7 (8.4s - 10.0s): Smooth medium pan showing the finished profile placed on top of a neat stack of identical U-channels stacked outdoors. Transparent subtle brand overlay: 'OliveTree Builders'. Tamil VO: 'ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ பில்டர்ஸ் தரமான வேலை.'

Continuity & Style Rules: Maintain consistent daylight lighting, realistic metal sheen, natural dust, correct safety gear on workers, consistent worker clothing, high sharpness, realistic 9:16 vertical framings without letterboxing.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: animation, cartoon, 3D render, CGI, glossy explainer graphics, landscape frame, letterbox, black bars, floating documents, fake landmarks, presenter facing camera, studio lighting, over-saturated colors, missing safety gear.
pack.title_english: Site Sheet Bending Jig for Perfect Edge Profiles
pack.caption_english: Achieving tight, uniform metal profiles on-site requires consistent mechanical leverage rather than loose hand-folding. Using a rigid manual bending brake on our Coimbatore residential sites ensures every sheet metal channel bends to an exact 90-degree angle for leak-free roof flashing and edge protection. Quality construction starts with precise site tooling. Partner with OliveTree Builders for uncompromised structural quality across Coimbatore.
